theorem divergence_velocity_on {H K : Profile} {times : Set ℝ}
    (hH : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 H (times ×ˢ (univ : Set (ℝ × ℝ))))
    (hK : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 K (times ×ˢ (univ : Set (ℝ × ℝ))))
